title: Lexus GX 550
verdict: Lexus finally drew a GX with a ruler and gave the Overtrail a rear locker to match. The V8 is gone, though, and the first-year engines have an asterisk.

paragraphs: The third-generation GX looks like what people wanted the [[lexus/gx460|GX 460]] to look like: square, upright and visibly built for a trail. Underneath is the GA-F ladder-frame platform it shares with the new Prado, sold in the US as the [[land-cruiser/250-series|250 Series]] Land Cruiser, and with the [[lexus/lx600|LX 600]]. It also has a 349-hp twin-turbo V6, a 10-speed automatic, full-time four-wheel drive through a locking Torsen center differential and, on the Overtrail grades, the first factory rear locker ever fitted to a GX.

story.heading: REVEALED BEFORE ITS OWN TWIN
paragraphs: Lexus showed the GX on June 8, 2023, ahead of the Land Cruiser Prado it's based on, which tells you how important the GX had become in America. The GX 460 was outselling itself in old age, with US sales above 30,000 in both 2021 and 2023. Production of the new truck started in November 2023 at Toyota's Tahara plant in Japan, the only place the GX is built.

The Overtrail grades grew out of Lexus's 'Overtrail Project,' first shown at the Tokyo Outdoor Show. They get 33-inch all-terrain tires on 18-inch wheels, a body 4.52 in wider than the old GX, E-KDSS and an electronically locking rear differential. Expedition Portal's first look called it the best overland Lexus yet 'by a wide margin.' It also noted the front fascia was designed with aftermarket bumpers and hidden winch mounts in mind.

story.heading: WHAT CHANGED UNDERNEATH
paragraphs: The 4.6-liter V8 is gone. In its place is the V35A-FTS 3.4-liter twin-turbo V6 from the LX 600 and Tundra, tuned here to 349 hp and 479 lb-ft. That's 48 more hp and 150 more lb-ft than the 460. The wheelbase grows to 112 in, which Expedition Portal points out is the same as the 80, 100 and 200 Series Land Cruiser wagons. KDSS goes electronic: E-KDSS can decouple the front and rear anti-roll bars at the push of a button instead of relying on purely hydraulic balancing.

Lexus also fitted a redesigned transfer case with faster high-low shifts and a center diff that splits torque 50:50. Multi-Terrain Select gets Auto, Sand, Mud and Rock modes in low range, plus Auto, Dirt, Sand, Mud and Deep Snow in high. Five-speed Crawl Control returns. The official angles are 26° approach, 24° breakover and 21° departure. The EPA rates it at 15 mpg city, 21 highway and 17 combined, which is only a modest improvement over the V8.

story.heading: THE ASTERISK
paragraphs: The V35A arrived with baggage. In November 2025, Toyota filed recall 25V-767 covering about 127,000 Tundras and Lexus LXs and GXs whose engines may contain machining debris that can damage the main bearings. Possible symptoms include knocking, rough running, a no-start or a loss of power while driving. The GX population is 3,717 US-market 2024 trucks built between May 31, 2023 and April 10, 2024. At filing, Lexus said the remedy was still being developed. It has since been set: dealers inspect the No. 1 main bearing using inspection software and drive data and replace the engine if needed, and owner letters went out on August 28, 2026.

Toyota's report says some later engines were made with improved manufacturing processes and some with an improved main bearing. For a used buyer, that makes the VIN check the most important step in any GX 550 inspection. Buyers clearly didn't flinch. US sales reached 30,914 in 2024 and 37,180 in 2025, the best year the GX has ever had in the US. The square GX turned out to be the one Lexus should have built years ago, and the platform it shares with the [[4runner/6th-gen|6th-gen 4Runner]] and the 250 means the aftermarket arrived early.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · OVERTRAIL VS. EVERYTHING ELSE
callout.title: What the Overtrail actually adds
paragraphs: Every GX 550 has full-time 4WD, low range and a Torsen center diff that locks. The Overtrail and Overtrail+ add the hardware enthusiasts actually care about: an electronically locking rear differential (engaged from a console switch), E-KDSS that disconnects the front and rear anti-roll bars for articulation, and standard 33-inch all-terrain tires on 18-inch wheels. The body is 4.52 in wider than the GX 460's, compared with 3.74 in for other grades.

The trade-offs are space and towing. Lexus lists seven seats only for the Premium, Premium+, Luxury and Luxury+ grades. On 2027 specs, towing runs from 7,601 lb (Luxury+) to 9,096 lb (Overtrail), so the off-road trim also happens to tow the most.

engineering_intro: The GX 550 rides on the GA-F platform, a ladder frame shared with the LX 600, the Land Cruiser 250/Prado and, according to Expedition Portal, the 300 Series and the Tundra. Front suspension is a new double wishbone design, the rear is multi-link, and AVS adaptive damping is available. Full-time 4WD runs through a redesigned two-speed transfer case and a Torsen limited-slip center differential that locks. Overtrail grades add an electronic rear locker and E-KDSS.

engineering.note: Shared with the LX 600 and the Land Cruiser 250/Prado. 112-in wheelbase.
349 hp and 479 lb-ft. 2024 engines are covered by recall 25V-767.
Torsen LSD center diff with a lock, 50:50 split. Faster high/low range shifts.
Electronically controlled and switched from the console. There's no front locker.
AVS available. E-KDSS, which disconnects the anti-roll bars, is standard on the Overtrail grades.

generations_table.note: Premium and Premium+. Seven seats. 2027 towing ratings are 9,063 lb and 9,041 lb.
Luxury and Luxury+. Seven seats and AVS. 2027 towing ratings are 7,844 lb and 7,601 lb.
Overtrail and Overtrail+. Rear e-locker, E-KDSS, 33-in A/T tires on 18s and a 4.52 in wider body. 2027 towing rating is 9,096 lb.
3,717 US trucks are in engine recall 25V-767. Launch towing rating was 8,000 lb.

buying_checks.head: Run the VIN for 25V-767
buying_checks.body: 2024 GX 550s built May 31, 2023 to April 10, 2024 may be in the engine debris recall (Lexus campaign 25LA07). Check lexus.com/recall or nhtsa.gov/recalls, and get the dealer paperwork showing what was done.

buying_checks.head: Listen to a cold start
buying_checks.body: The recall's listed symptoms are knocking, rough running, a no-start and a loss of power. Any knock from a V35A is a stop-and-ask-questions noise, not a negotiating point.

buying_checks.head: Overtrail or not?
buying_checks.body: If you want the rear locker, E-KDSS and 33s from the factory, it has to be an Overtrail or Overtrail+. Other grades have the locking center diff but no axle locker.

buying_checks.head: Seats vs. capability
buying_checks.body: Seven seats are listed only on the Premium and Luxury grades. Families that need a third row are buying a different GX from the overlanders.

buying_checks.head: Tire upgrades
buying_checks.body: Trucks already on bigger tires may have a top-shock spacer or adjusted control arms. Ask what was done to clear them, and check for rub marks on the liners at full lock.

buying_checks.head: Aftermarket wiring
buying_checks.body: Lights, compressors and dual batteries are popular early mods. Look for tidy fusing and switch panels, not taps into factory harnesses.

repairs.title: Engine recall 25LA07 (25V-767) check
repairs.time: ≈ 10 minutes to check. Dealer time varies.
repairs.symptoms: Possible engine knocking, rough running, a no-start or a loss of motive power. Many affected trucks show no symptoms.
repairs.fix: Enter the VIN at lexus.com/recall or nhtsa.gov/recalls. NHTSA's recall record now gives the remedy: dealers inspect the No. 1 main bearing using inspection software and drive data and replace the engine if necessary, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed August 28, 2026. If your truck is affected, get the inspection result, and any engine replacement, in writing and keep the records. Future buyers will ask.

repairs.title: Fitting 33–35 in tires
repairs.symptoms: Not a fault. You want more sidewall and clearance than the factory tires provide.
repairs.fix: Owners report 265/70R18 on factory suspension and many running 275/70R18 (about 33.2 in) without modification. One GX 550 owner runs 275/70R18 KO3s on stock wheels with an 8 mm top shock spacer and billet rear lower control arms and has no rub at full articulation. 285/70 is where rubbing starts. 35s generally need a small level or lift, and one owner of the twin LC250 runs 35x11.50R18 with a 1.5-in front lift and a 15 mm rear spacer.
repairs.tools: Floor jack · stands · spring compressor if using spacers · torque wrench · alignment afterward

parts.name: OME MT64 1.5–2 in low lift, LC 250/GX 550
DuroBumps rear bump stop kit, LC 250/GX 550

repairs.title: Oil and filter change on the V35A-FTS
repairs.cost: Oil, a filter and a drain-plug gasket
repairs.symptoms: The oil maintenance reminder is on, or it's been 10,000 miles or 12 months since the last change. Lexus's schedule cuts that to 5,000 miles or 6 months if you mostly drive dirt or dusty roads, make short trips below freezing, or idle a lot.
repairs.fix: Lexus's GX 550 owner's manual calls for ILSAC GF-6A SAE 0W-20. You can use 5W-20 in a pinch, but the manual says to go back to 0W-20 at the next change. It lists 7.7 qt with the filter and 7.4 qt without. The filter and drain plug are underneath. On the LC250, which shares the GA-F body but not the engine, owners on IH8MUD's oil-change thread say only the front skid plate has to come off. Several found the factory filter fitted very tightly, so have a cap-style wrench ready. AMSOIL's GX 550 lookup gives 30 ft-lb for the drain plug with a new gasket. Refill, warm the engine, shut it off, wait about five minutes and read the dipstick, as the manual describes. Then reset the oil maintenance reminder, which the manual lists among the items to initialize.
repairs.tools: Cap-style filter wrench · drain pan · torque wrench · tools for the front skid plate · a funnel that reaches into the filler neck (an LC250 owner found a standard funnel won't stay upright) · new drain-plug gasket. An LX 600 owner on the same thread, whose truck has the same V35A, uses Toyota filter 90915-10010. Confirm the filter for your VIN with a Lexus parts counter.

repairs.title: Cabin filter, engine air filters and wiper blades
repairs.symptoms: Weak airflow from the vents, a musty smell, a dusty filter after trail miles, or wipers that streak. The 2024 Lexus schedule replaces both the engine air filter and the cabin air filter every 30,000 miles and inspects the wiper blades at every service.
repairs.fix: Cabin filter, from the owner's manual: turn the engine switch off, open the glove box and lift out its removable tray, then remove the panel behind it. Unlock the filter cover, ease it out of its claws without forcing them, and pull out the filter case. Fit the new filter so the 'UP' marks on the filter and the case both point up. Lexus warns against running the A/C with no filter in place. Engine air: the manual doesn't give a procedure, but it does warn that driving with the air cleaner filter removed can cause excessive engine wear. K&N's fitment listing for the 3.4 V6 says two filters are required, so plan on buying a pair. On a dusty trip, check them more often than the 30,000-mile interval.
repairs.tools: Hands, plus a trim tool for the glove-box panel · shop vac for the airboxes

parts.name: K&N engine air filter, 2024 GX 550 3.4 V6 (2 required)

repairs.title: Front brake squeal and pad checks
repairs.time: ≈ 15 minutes to inspect · 1–2 hours for front pads
repairs.cost: Covered under warranty if the bulletin applies; otherwise pads, hardware and fluid
repairs.symptoms: A squeal from the front brakes when driving forward or in reverse. Lexus bulletin L-SB-0036-24 covers it on some 2024 GX 550s. Owners of the twin LC250 on LandCruiserForum mostly hear it first thing in the morning, or when it's cold and humid.
repairs.fix: If the truck is under warranty, start at the dealer and ask about L-SB-0036-24. A LandCruiserForum member said the bulletin repair is almost a carbon copy of a Tundra fix. On the LC250, where a Toyota representative said there was no Toyota-side bulletin, one dealer replaced the front pads, rotors and pad shims under warranty. Some owners found the squeal faded after a series of moderate-to-hard stops, but for others it came back. For your own checks, the Lexus schedule inspects pads and discs every 5,000 miles. The owner's manual gives a pad wear limit of 0.04 in (1 mm) and accepts DOT 3 or DOT 4 brake fluid. It also says the reservoir level drops slightly as the pads wear. Torque the wheel nuts to 97 ft-lb and recheck them after 1,000 miles.
repairs.tools: Torque wrench to 100 ft-lb · caliper piston tool or large C-clamp · brake cleaner · pad-slide grease · fluid baster for the reservoir

repairs.title: Tire rotation, wheel swaps and TPMS registration
repairs.cost: Free if you do it; new sensors for a second wheel set
repairs.symptoms: It's 5,000 miles since the last rotation. Or the tire positions are wrong on the display after a rotation, or you're fitting a second set of wheels. If the sensor IDs aren't registered, the manual says the TPMS light blinks for a minute after about 20 minutes of driving and then stays on.
repairs.fix: The Lexus schedule rotates the tires every 5,000 miles. Torque the wheel nuts to 97 ft-lb and recheck them after 1,000 miles. After a rotation, register the wheel positions. Park for 15 minutes or more with the engine off, then start it and choose Vehicle customize > Tire pressure > Tire rotation > Continue on the center display. Drive at about 25 mph or faster, with occasional left and right turns, for 10–30 minutes. Reversing clears the data. New sensors use 'New tire registration' on the same menu, and the GX stores two sets of IDs ('Set 1' and 'Set 2'), so a winter or trail wheel set can be swapped in about two minutes once registered. If you change tire size or run different pressures, set the tires cold and then use 'Set current air pressure.' Lexus warns the system may not work properly on non-genuine wheels. Every wheel needs a sensor. The spare hangs under the rear on a chain, and the holding bracket is tightened to 34.7 ft-lb.
repairs.tools: Floor jack and stands · torque wrench · tire gauge · a quiet road for the registration drive

repairs.title: 12V battery: test, jump-start or replace
repairs.cost: A battery, or nothing for a test
repairs.symptoms: Slow cranking or a no-start, the smart access system not unlocking the doors, or a red or clear eye in the battery indicator (on trucks that have one). Blue means good, clear means it needs charging, and red means replace.
repairs.fix: The battery sits under the engine compartment cover: push the tab in, pull the lock release, lift the cover, then pull it forward. To jump-start, open the positive terminal cover, remove the engine cover, and connect to the positive terminal and the metal ground point the manual shows (not the negative terminal). Run the donor vehicle for about five minutes before you try to start. To replace, turn the engine switch off, disconnect the negative terminal first, and fit a battery with the same LN4 case size, at least 80 Ah (20-hour rate) and at least 689 CCA. The manual warns that a battery of a different size can't be secured properly, and an unsuitable one may not restart the engine. Afterwards, re-initialize the power back door, and the moonroof and power running boards if fitted, plus the power windows if they act up. The engine may not start on the first try after reconnection. If you're planning a dual-battery setup, a GX 550 owner on IH8MUD says there's practically no room under the hood with the twin turbos, intakes and intercooler, so he put a lithium battery and a DC-DC charger behind the second row.
repairs.tools: Socket set · battery tester or multimeter (12.3 V or higher with the headlights test in the manual) · jumper cables · terminal brush. The smart key uses a CR2032, which the schedule replaces at 30,000 miles. Lexus recommends a dealer do it.

repairs.title: Clear the camera, cluster and label recalls
repairs.time: ≈ 10 minutes to check. Dealer or over-the-air update.
repairs.symptoms: The rearview camera freezes or goes blank in reverse on trucks with Panoramic View Monitor (25V-744, 2024–2025). The instrument cluster may not show some warnings or indicators (26V-341, 2024). The load-carrying-capacity modification label may show the wrong values (26V-179, 2024–2025).
repairs.fix: Run the VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or lexus.com/recall. NHTSA's records give the remedies. For 25V-744, dealers update the parking-assist software (Lexus 25LB06). For 26V-341, the combination-meter software is updated over the air (Lexus 26LA06/26LB06). For 26V-179, dealers replace the label (Lexus 26LA04/26LB04). Note that NHTSA's database lists the truck as model 'GX', so a search for 'GX 550' can come back empty. The Lexus schedule also checks for available over-the-air software updates at every service.
repairs.tools: VIN · Lexus dealer · cellular or Wi-Fi connection for the OTA update

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: The Overtrail comes on 33-inch all-terrains and 18-inch wheels. On IH8MUD's LC250/GX550 tire thread, 265/70R18 fits with no problems and many owners run 275/70R18 (about 33.2 in) without mods. 285/70R18 is where rubbing starts. 35s generally need a level or small lift.
At launch, Lexus quoted up to 8,000 lb. Current Lexus specs list it by grade: 9,063 lb (Premium), 9,041 lb (Premium+), 7,844 lb (Luxury), 7,601 lb (Luxury+) and 9,096 lb (Overtrail).

faq.q: What fuel economy should I expect?
faq.a: The EPA rates it at 15 mpg city, 21 highway and 17 combined. Expedition Portal called the combined figure a surprise, even though it beats the GX 460.

faq.q: Is my GX 550 part of the engine recall?
faq.a: Possibly, if it's a 2024. Recall 25V-767 (Lexus 25LA07) covers 3,717 US-market 2024 GXs built between May 31, 2023 and April 10, 2024, for machining debris that can damage the engine. Check your VIN at lexus.com/recall or nhtsa.gov. The remedy is a No. 1 main-bearing inspection, with engine replacement if needed.

faq.q: What does the Overtrail get that other grades don't?
faq.a: An electronically locking rear differential, E-KDSS that disconnects the anti-roll bars, standard 33-inch A/T tires on 18s, and a wider body. Seven seats are listed only for the non-Overtrail grades.

It's full-time 4WD on every GX 550, with a Torsen limited-slip center differential that locks and splits torque 50:50. A two-speed transfer case gives you low range. Multi-Terrain Select offers Auto, Sand, Mud and Rock in low range, and Auto, Dirt, Sand, Mud and Deep Snow in high. Crawl Control works in low range at five speeds.

faq.q: Is it a Land Cruiser underneath?
faq.a: Yes. It shares the GA-F platform with the Land Cruiser Prado, sold in the US as the Land Cruiser 250, and with the LX 600. The GX was revealed first, on June 8, 2023.
Lexus quotes up to 26° approach, 24° breakover and 21° departure.
At launch, Lexus said a hybrid powertrain would come to the US later. US GX 550s use the 3.4-liter twin-turbo V6.

faq.q: V6 or the old V8: which is stronger?
faq.a: On paper, the V6. It makes 349 hp and 479 lb-ft, compared with 301 hp and 329 lb-ft from the GX 460's 4.6 V8. The V8's advantage is its long track record, while the V35A is still early in its story and has had recalls.

faq.q: What oil does it take, and how much?
faq.a: Lexus's owner's manual calls for ILSAC GF-6A 0W-20 and lists 7.7 qt with a new filter (7.4 qt without). 5W-20 is allowed only as a stopgap until the next change. The standard interval is 10,000 miles or 12 months, or 6 months / 5,000 miles if you mostly drive dirt or dusty roads, make short trips below freezing, or idle a lot.

mods.why: Leveling and arms let you run 33–35s without rubbing and give back some droop.
The Overtrail nose was styled with aftermarket bumpers and winch mounts in mind. Skids and sliders follow.
A flat rack makes room for a tent and recovery gear while keeping the GX garageable.
275/70R18 is the popular no-lift step up from the factory 33s.

baseline_service.intro: The GX 550 is new, so a baseline mostly confirms the engine recall status and the service history, then starts the off-road fluid intervals. Intervals below come from the 2024 Lexus schedule; fluid types and capacities come from the current GX 550 owner's manual (OM6A563U). The manual calls its capacities reference quantities, so fill to the level marks.

items.spec: ILSAC GF-6A SAE 0W-20 (5W-20 only as a stopgap) · 7.7 qt (7.3 L) with filter, 7.4 qt without · drain plug 30 ft-lb (AMSOIL)
items.interval: At purchase, then every 10,000 mi / 12 months. Every 5,000 mi / 6 months for off-road, towing or dusty use.
items.note: The filter and drain plug are underneath, behind the front skid plate. Reset the oil maintenance reminder afterwards.

items.interval: Every 30,000 mi. Inspect more often off-road.
items.note: K&N's fitment listing says the 3.4 V6 takes two filters.

items.spec: DENSO EC22HPR-D7 iridium · gap 0.028 in (0.7 mm); don't adjust the gap
items.interval: Every 40,000 mi (40k, 80k and 120k in the 2024 schedule)

items.spec: Toyota Super Long Life or equivalent non-silicate, non-amine, non-nitrite, non-borate HOAT coolant · engine 13.8 qt (16.1 qt with rear A/C), intercooler 3.9 qt
items.interval: First at 100,000 mi / 120 months, then every 50,000 mi / 60 months
items.note: The schedule lists the engine and intercooler coolant together. Lexus says to have a dealer do the replacement.

items.spec: Toyota Genuine ATF WS · 11.73 qt total (reference); AMSOIL lists 5.4 qt as the initial fill
items.interval: Every 60,000 mi if you tow, carry heavy loads or idle a lot
items.note: Lexus warns that any other fluid can cause noise, vibration or damage, and says to see a dealer for replacement.

items.spec: Toyota Genuine Transfer Gear Oil LF, SAE 75W · 1.88 qt
Toyota Genuine Differential Gear Oil LT 75W-85 GL-5 · front 1.23 qt · rear 7.22 qt, or 6.87 qt with the rear locker
items.note: Overtrail trucks with the rear locker take slightly less oil in the rear.
The manual's pad wear limit is 0.04 in (1 mm).

items.spec: Vacuum pump vane and vane caps
items.note: This is a GX 550-specific schedule item. The guide says never to reuse the old caps.

items.interval: At purchase, then within 24 hours of any water crossing
items.note: The schedule also calls for tightening the propeller shaft bolts if you tow.

parts.name: Red-i hi-temp and moly grease kit (6 tubes)

items.spec: LN4 case · at least 80 Ah (20-hour rate) and 689 CCA
items.note: After a battery swap, re-initialize the power back door (and the moonroof and running boards if fitted).

items.spec: Overtrail 265/70R18 at 35 psi; 20s and 22s at 33 psi · wheel nuts 97 ft-lb
items.interval: Rotate every 5,000 mi (2024 schedule), then register wheel positions
items.note: Check the spare too. It hangs under the rear on a chain.
